agentGuidance.purpose: The official Excalidraw MCP (mcp.excalidraw.com) as Marshal capabilities: draw hand-drawn diagrams that render as an Excalidraw card in the chat, then share them on excalidraw.com or save .excalidraw files.
agentGuidance.when: The user wants a diagram, sketch, whiteboard, flowchart, architecture or sequence picture drawn in the chat, or wants an existing Excalidraw diagram changed, shared or saved.
agentGuidance.recipe: 1) excalidraw.guide once per conversation (element format, palette, camera rules). 2) excalidraw.draw {elements, title}: shows the card and returns checkpointId (pass slot to place it inside your reply at a <!--ui:<slot>--> line). 3) To change it: excalidraw.checkpoint.read {checkpointId} for the user's edits, then excalidraw.draw with [{"type":"restoreCheckpoint","id":checkpointId}, ...new elements] and {"type":"delete","ids":"a,b"}; pass instanceId to redraw the same card. 4) excalidraw.export {checkpointId} for a shareable excalidraw.com link; excalidraw.save {checkpointId, path} for a .excalidraw file. Raw MCP tools: excalidraw.mcp.list_tools / excalidraw.mcp.call.
agentGuidance.boundaries: Diagram elements are sent to Excalidraw's hosted MCP server and stored there as checkpoints. excalidraw.export publishes an unlisted link anyone with the URL can open: only when the user asks to share or open in Excalidraw. Never put secrets in diagrams.
